en_title: Subway Is Releasing a GTA 6-Themed Sandwich, but There's a Catch
cn_title: Subway推出《GTA6》主题三明治，但有一个限制
opus_summary: Subway宣布将迈阿密限定的Cubano Pulled Pork Melt换上《GTA6》主题包装，更名为Vice City Cubano，提供堂食购买和外送。Popeyes也将推出限时一周的Vice City主题鸡肉三明治，迈阿密多家餐饮店和商店则与Rockstar合作提供主题餐饮。

paragraphs.en: Subway is getting on the GTA 6 hype train with a sandwich themed after the highly anticipated game.
paragraphs.cn: Subway搭上了《GTA6》的热潮，推出一款以这款备受期待的游戏为主题的三明治。

paragraphs.en: The sandwich chain announced today that it is giving its Miami-exclusive Cubano Pulled Pork Melt a GTA 6 "reskin" in time for the new game. The sandwich is being renamed the Vice City Cubano and, as noted, is only available in the city of Miami. The sandwich comes either as a six-inch or footlong sub and features hardwood-smoked pulled pork, black forest ham, melted provolone, pickles, and mustard on freshly baked artisan Italian bread.
paragraphs.cn: 这家连锁三明治店今天宣布，将赶在新游戏推出之际，为其迈阿密独售的Cubano Pulled Pork Melt三明治换上《GTA6》的「新皮肤」。这款三明治更名为Vice City Cubano，如前所述，仅在迈阿密市有售。三明治有六英寸或一英尺长两种规格，采用新鲜烘烤的手工意大利面包，夹有硬木熏制手撕猪肉、黑森林火腿、融化的普罗卧干酪、酸黄瓜和芥末酱。

paragraphs.en: Subway confirmed that the sandwich will be available both in-store and for delivery for those who don't plan to leave their couch when GTA 6 is released. You can see an image of it below.
paragraphs.cn: Subway确认，这款三明治既可在店内购买，也可供那些不打算在《GTA6》发售时离开沙发的人订购外送。你可以在下方看到它的图片。

paragraphs.en: Subway isn't the only fast food place getting in on on the GTA 6 hype. Popeyes is also releasing a Vice City-themed chicken sandwich that it calls "Spice City." It will be available for one week starting November 19 and is available at participating locations for in-store pick up or delivery. Finally, there are also a bunch of Miami-based dining options and stores that have officially teamed up with Rockstar to provide themed meals and drinks based on GTA. The most notable of the bunch is a partnership with Skinny Louie, a burger chain based out of Florida.
paragraphs.cn: Subway并不是唯一一家加入《GTA6》热潮的快餐店。Popeyes也将推出一款以Vice City为主题的鸡肉三明治，名为「Spice City」。这款三明治从11月19日起供应一周，可在参与活动的门店自取或订购外送。最后，还有许多位于迈阿密的餐饮场所和商店已与Rockstar正式合作，提供基于《GTA》的主题餐食和饮品。其中最引人注目的是与佛罗里达州汉堡连锁店Skinny Louie的合作。

paragraphs.en: The chain has been turned into Burger Shot , a fast food joint prominently featured in the GTA franchise. The menu, uniforms, packaging, and signange for Skinny Louie has been completely refitted with Burger Shot branding, which will remain in place until the end of the year. Rockstar's marketing power has reached unprecedented levels, even prompting other places that don't have a partnership in place to try and ride the hype waves.
paragraphs.cn: 这家连锁店已变身为Burger Shot，一家在《GTA》系列中占据显著地位的快餐店。Skinny Louie的菜单、制服、包装和招牌已全部换上Burger Shot品牌标识，并将保持至年底。Rockstar的营销实力已达到前所未有的水平，甚至促使其他没有建立合作关系的商家也试图搭上这股热潮。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 will release this Thursday for Xbox Series X|S and PS5. Players can pre-load the game right now and they absolutely should, as the game is a whopping 210 GBs.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》将于本周四登陆XBOX Series和PS5。玩家现在就可以预载游戏，而且绝对应该这么做，因为游戏大小高达210 GB。
